prompt: A navigator needs to report a heading of $18.25^\circ$ in degrees and minutes. How many minutes should be reported along with the $18^\circ$?
hint: The whole-degree part is $18^\circ$. The leftover to convert is $0.25^\circ$.

hints.text: The whole-degree part is $18^\circ$. The leftover to convert is $0.25^\circ$.
Each degree holds 60 minutes, so multiply: $0.25 \times 60$.

explanation: Split the angle into whole degrees and a leftover: $18.25^\circ = 18^\circ + 0.25^\circ$.
Since one degree is 60 minutes, multiply the leftover by 60: $0.25 \times 60 = 15$.
The heading is $18^\circ 15'$, so 15 minutes get reported.

alternativeExplanations.title: Quarter of an hour
steps: $0.25$ of anything is a quarter of it.
A quarter of an hour is 15 minutes, and a quarter of a degree is 15 minutes for exactly the same reason: $\frac{60}{4} = 15$.
